[1] [GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Time Away & Leave > Sick Leave]
**GitLab Canada Corp Entitlement**

- **Annual Allowance**: 10 days per year (3 days available after first month of employment)
- **Usage**: For illness, medical appointments, or caring for sick family members
- **Reporting**: Designate time as "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking

**Provincial Statutory Requirements**

- **Ontario**: 3 days job-protected unpaid sick leave (after 2+ weeks employment)
- **Quebec**: 2 days paid absence per calendar year

**Extended Sick Leave (5+ days)**

- GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to 25 working days
- Additional 25 working days available for family care if not covered by provincial benefits
- Contact Absence Management team at leaves@domain.com
- Medical documentation may be required per local requirements

Provincial Leave Types and Request

Each province offers comprehensive leave entitlements including bereavement, family responsibility, critical illness, domestic violence, and specialized circumstances.

[2] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Time Off Policies > Sick Leave]
Support when you're unwell.

Leave Entitlement

Effective 6 April 2026, two significant changes apply to Statutory Sick Pay eligibility and payment.

- All team members are eligible for SSP from their first day of employment. The previous Lower Earnings Limit (requiring team members to earn at least GBP 125 per week to qualify) is abolished.
- Statutory Sick Pay for up to 28 weeks
- Runs concurrently with [GitLab Sick Time](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

How to Report

- 4-7 days absence: Complete [self-certification form](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Cy-xUgWwNKroUEEJ0ut80HGVA0d3RJV5mQO-amLjoCs/edit?usp=sharing)
- 7+ days absence: Provide fit note to leaves@gitlab.com
- Select "Out Sick" in Workday

[3] [Time Off Types > Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) > Sick Time > Sick Time Eligibility and Coverage]
- GitLab’s Sick Time policy is administered *concurrently* with any statutory sick leave for which you may be eligible.
- Each GitLab team member may use up to 25 paid sick days, available from their first day of work. Eligibility is calculated on a rolling 12-month period.
  - *What does a rolling 12-month period mean?* A rolling 12-month calendar refers to a period that always spans exactly 12 consecutive months, but continuously shifts forward as time passes, so the start and end dates move forward together while maintaining a constant 12-month window.

[4] [GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Statutory Sick Leave**]
Comprehensive sick leave coverage that builds over time, supporting you during illness while running alongside GitLab's additional sick time support.

Leave Entitlement & Key Details

**Sick Leave Entitlement:**

- **Eligibility:** 10 days statutory sick leave after 6 months continuous employment
- **Annual entitlement:** 10 days per 12-month period after meeting initial criteria
- **Carry over:** If in any year the team member doesn't meet the criteria, then they don't get any new sick leave entitlement, but can use their sick leave balance which may have carried over. An employee may re-qualify for sick leave as soon as they meet the criteria.
- **Maximum accumulation:** 20 days under New Zealand's Holidays Act 2003
- **Additional Support:** Runs concurrently with [GitLab's Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

**How to Apply:**

1. Contact leaves@gitlab.com when taking sick leave
2. Medical certificate may be required per Holidays Act
3. Select "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking
4. Unused sick leave is not paid out upon employment termination

[5] [Time Off Types > Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) > Caregiver Sick Time > Caregiver Sick Time Eligibility and Coverage]
- GitLab's Caregiver Sick Time policy is administered *concurrently* with any statutory family care leave for which you may be eligible.
  - If you live in a country or state where a statutory benefit is available, you will be required to apply for statutory leave pay (if eligible), and GitLab will supplement your pay to equal 100% of your weekly wages. You will not receive more than 100% of your wages with statutory leave and Caregiver Leave combined.
- Each GitLab team member may use up to 25 paid caregiver sick days, available from their first day of work. Eligibility is calculated on a rolling 12-month period.
  - *What does a rolling 12-month period mean?* A rolling 12-month calendar refers to a period that always spans exactly 12 consecutive months, but continuously shifts forward as time passes, so the start and end dates move forward together while maintaining a constant 12-month window.

[6] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Team members must have continuous employment with GitLab for at least 26 weeks leading up to the "qualifying week" (15th week before the expected week of childbirth)
- Up to 52 weeks leave available
- First 39 weeks paid (combining statutory and GitLab benefits)
- 90% of average earnings for first 6 weeks (before tax), then statutory rate (£194.32/week) or 90% (whichever is lower) of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for the next 33 weeks. This also applies to the leave amounts provided for Parental Leave and Adoption Leave.
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary

How to Apply

Question: If I move from GitLab Canada Corp to GitLab LTD (UK), how does my sick leave entitlement change in terms of paid days and eligibility for statutory benefits?

Answer:
Under GitLab Canada Corp, you are entitled to 10 annual sick days, with 3 days available after the first month of employment [1]. In contrast, GitLab LTD (UK) provides Statutory Sick Pay for up to 28 weeks, with eligibility starting from the first day of employment effective April 2026 [2]. Both entities administer their statutory benefits concurrently with GitLab's global Sick Time policy, which allows up to 25 paid sick days on a rolling 12-month basis [1][2][3].
